summary: Frontend-only verification of Jeana Marie's Kitchen Club wording decisions (Family Kitchen tier, Five Books heading, audience sentence, meta tags, forbidden phrases, dashboard/library/book routes, legacy /adult redirect, teen recipe). All 31 substantive assertions pass. Ran frontend unit tests: 43/43 pass across 3 suites (tiers.test.js, wording.test.js, api.test.js). One important environmental note: /app/frontend/public/index.html changes to <meta> tags were NOT reflected on the served page until the frontend service was restarted (CRA dev-server does not hot-reload public/index.html). After 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend' the served HTML matched the approved copy exactly. No emails were sent, no Stripe calls, no data mutations.
action_items: None — all wording checks pass in Preview after the required frontend restart. Main agent should be aware that whenever public/index.html is edited, `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` is required for the CRA dev-server to pick it up (hot-reload does not cover index.html).

public/index.html <meta> tags are static (correct approach), but note that any future copy edits to index.html require a frontend restart in dev; consider documenting this in README to avoid confusion.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Wording verified as of iter16: Family Kitchen tier skills contain em-dash (U+2014) — do NOT accept a plain hyphen. Meta description/og:description must be exact. legacy /app/book/adult must still render h1='Family Kitchen'. Frontend must be restarted after any public/index.html edit for CRA to serve updated meta tags. Frontend unit tests: cd /app/frontend && CI=true yarn craco test --watchAll=false src/lib → 3 suites, 43 tests, all passing. Public URL: https://recipe-journal-club.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: Initial run showed served <meta name=description> containing legacy 'Cooking and learning activities for families.' text plus duplicated audience content. Root cause: CRA dev-server serves public/index.html from an in-memory copy taken at process start; edits made after start are not hot-reloaded. Mitigation: sudo supervisorctl restart frontend after modifying public/index.html. After restart, curl of raw HTML and Playwright evaluate both returned the exact approved strings, and all downstream checks passed.
